string-array.name: sgula_meditation_quiz
string-array.item: I want to release tension in my body
I want to quiet racing thoughts

string-array.name: sgula_quiz_sample
string-array.item: I felt calm for most of the day.
I had a few rough patches.
I struggled to settle at all.

string-array.name: sgula_journal_prompts
string-array.item: What made you feel calm today?
What is one small thing you did for yourself today?
Which moment today would you like to remember?
What felt heavy today, and what helped you carry it?
Who or what are you grateful for right now?
What did your body need today, and did it get it?
What is something you handled better than you expected?
What thought kept coming back today? Write it down and look at it kindly.
Where did you notice growth in yourself this week?
What would you like to let go of before tomorrow?
Describe a place where you feel safe. What makes it feel that way?
What is one gentle intention for tomorrow?
What boundary did you keep, or wish you had kept, today?
What would you say to a friend who had the day you had?
